expression: (async()=>{const s=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).find(e=>e.shadowRoot).shadowRoot;const select=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="选择要查看的历史状态"]');const initial=Array.from(select.options).find(o=>o.textContent==='初始状态');select.value=initial.value;select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const historical=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>s.querySelector('#option-'+i).disabled);select.value='latest';select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return {historical,latest:[0,1,2,3].map(i=>s.querySelector('#option-'+i).disabled),feedback:s.querySelector('[data-option-feedback]').textContent}})()
